executiveSummary: Five education-addressable themes emerged from this signal batch; the highest-leverage is weak first-run onboarding, which caps the value of every other improvement because 70% of new orgs never reach a second call. We recommend leading with an onboarding quickstart, then long-context guidance (with the Acme story) and a Realtime reconnect FAQ. The Realtime per-minute billing surprise is out of scope for education and has been routed to Pricing/Product.

priorities.title: Enterprise first-success quickstart + guided path
priorities.expectedImpact: Raise the 7-day second-call rate; reduce time-to-first-success for new enterprise orgs.
priorities.rationale: Largest reach and clearest knowledge/path gap; unblocks the value of all later assets.

priorities.title: Long-context vs RAG decision guide (+ Acme story)
priorities.expectedImpact: Eliminate chunking confusion and make the Acme win repeatable.
priorities.rationale: Quick win that also retires misleading guidance and leverages a ready success story.

priorities.title: Realtime API reconnect & troubleshooting FAQ
priorities.expectedImpact: Unblock first connections and lift Realtime trial conversion.
priorities.rationale: Cheap to ship; pair with a product investigation into the drops.

priorities.title: Fine-tuning migration quickstart
priorities.expectedImpact: De-risk at-risk accounts ahead of the Q4 deadline.

priorities.title: Production-agent reliability adoption guide
priorities.expectedImpact: Give sales a reliability proof narrative to unstick stalled deals.
priorities.rationale: Sales-enabling; compounds with customer proof points.
